description:
Book your tour: https://www.homeapartments.com.au/book-a-tour/ 

Positioned in the heart of the Docklands and located just next door to the Marvel Stadium entertainment precinct -

 Home Docklands has been designed just for renters. This as new 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment offer large kitchen with Island Bench, spacious living area, bedrooms, modern luxury and a high level of comfort. 

Key features include: 
- Practical and elegant bedrooms 
- Built-in robes - Ensuite bathroom to master 
- Sophisticated functional kitchen 
- Fisher & Paykel appliances
 -Integrated dishwasher 
- Spacious island bench with breakfast bar 
- Floor-to-ceiling windows 
- Large Private Balcony 
- All-year comfort with LG ducted air conditioning -
 Secure intercom system Enjoy the benefits and security of a long-term lease, 60-month lease terms are available.

 Please speak to our team for more information. We have an embedded electricity and Internet network, ensuring same-day connections and competitive pricing. You will also enjoy access to hotel style services and resident amenities including a co-working hub, pool, state-of-the-art gym, infrared sauna, podcast studio, private dining spaces, beats lounge and much more. *Images of display apartment. Outlook may vary from images used. 

*Parking options available
